Terms of Service

Legal version: 2026-05-31

These Terms of Service govern your use of Triangulate, including the website, app, events, gameplay features, leaderboards, and related services. By using Triangulate, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully, and in particular the sections on real-world safety, the disclaimer and assumption of risk, and our limitation of liability, which limit our responsibility to you.

Triangulate is provided by Ziv Lazar LTD, a company registered in England and Wales, whose registered office is at 15 Crusoe Mews, London, N16 0BQ, United Kingdom. In these terms, "Triangulate", "we", "us", and "our" mean Ziv Lazar LTD, and "you" means the person using Triangulate.

1. What Triangulate is

Triangulate is a team-based outdoor map game. Each team has three player slots. A slot can be filled by an outdoor real player or an AI player.

Outdoor players move using live device location. AI players are computer-controlled players provided by Triangulate. Solo play is a separate single-player practice scenario.

The main way to start a game is play a game. The lobby lets players build an outdoor team, invite friends, find teammates, add AI, and choose an enemy type. Enemy: Local | Country | Global | AI may be available as the enemy choice.

2. Who we are

Triangulate is operated by Ziv Lazar LTD, a company registered in England and Wales. Our registered office is at 15 Crusoe Mews, London, N16 0BQ, United Kingdom. If you need to contact us about these terms, please use the details in the Contact section below.

3. Children and parents

Triangulate is intended for a general audience and is not aimed at young children. You must be at least 13 years old to use Triangulate. If you are under 18, you may use Triangulate only with the permission and supervision of a parent or guardian. Parents and guardians are responsible for deciding whether a child may play Outdoors, and for supervising that play.

We design Triangulate with the interests of younger users in mind, in line with the Information Commissioner's Office Age Appropriate Design Code (the Children's Code). This includes privacy-protective defaults, collecting only the data we need, and keeping precise location switched off until a player chooses to play Outdoors.

Outdoor play uses live location and may involve real-world movement. Children should be supervised appropriately when playing Outdoors.

4. Playing Outdoors

Outdoors players move using live device location.

To play Outdoors, you must:

  • have permission to use the device location features;
  • enable the required location permissions;
  • use Precise Location where required;
  • play in a safe and lawful place;
  • stay aware of your surroundings;
  • obey local laws and rules;
  • avoid roads, traffic, dangerous areas, restricted areas, and private property;
  • stop playing if it is unsafe to continue.

Triangulate may block or pause outdoor play if GPS is unavailable, inaccurate, unstable, or appears to be manipulated.

5. Real-world safety

Triangulate is a game, not a navigation app and not a safety app. It is not a navigation service, a mapping or routing service, a safety guide, an emergency service, or an instruction to enter any location. You must not rely on Triangulate for directions, for the accuracy of any map, route, or position, or to keep you safe.

You are solely responsible for your own conduct, decisions, movement, and safety whilst playing Outdoors, and for the safety of anyone in your care. You must use your own judgement about where it is safe and lawful to go.

You must not:

  • trespass;
  • enter unsafe places;
  • enter restricted areas;
  • play while driving;
  • play while cycling in a way that distracts you;
  • cross roads without care;
  • ignore signs, barriers, weather, traffic, people, animals, or other real-world risks.

If the game map, route, arena, marker, or objective appears to direct you somewhere unsafe, unlawful, or restricted, do not go there. Always prioritise your safety and the safety of others over gameplay.

6. Disclaimer and assumption of risk

You play Triangulate at your own risk. Outdoor play takes place in the real world, in public and shared spaces that we do not own, operate, control, inspect, or monitor. Conditions in those spaces, including other people, traffic, terrain, weather, wildlife, and hazards, are outside our control.

By choosing to play Outdoors, you acknowledge and accept the ordinary and inherent risks of moving around outdoors, including the risk of injury, accident, loss, or damage, and you agree that you take responsibility for assessing those risks before and during play.

Triangulate is provided for entertainment only. Nothing in the app is advice, a recommendation, or an assurance that any place, route, or activity is safe, lawful, accessible, or suitable for you. The map, place data, and event information are drawn in part from third-party and open-data sources and may be inaccurate, incomplete, or out of date.

Nothing in this section limits the rights you have where the law does not allow them to be limited, including in relation to death or personal injury caused by our negligence (see the limitation of liability section below).

7. Events, meet-ups, and third parties

Triangulate may let players plan or join events and meet-ups at real-world places. We are not the organiser, host, promoter, or supervisor of any event, gathering, match, or meet-up, and we do not run, staff, steward, or provide any live event. The person who sets up an event in the app is a regular participant who chose a time and place; they are not our agent and are not an organiser, host, or official on our behalf.

Venues, parks, facilities, and locations shown in the app are operated by third parties under their own rules. You are responsible for checking and following the rules, opening hours, access conditions, and safety requirements of any place you visit, and for your own conduct and safety at any event or meet-up. We are not responsible for the acts, omissions, content, services, or safety of any venue, event participant, or other third party.

You must not trespass on, or encourage others to trespass on, private property in order to play or to reach a place shown in the app. If you are a property owner or occupier and a place or event appears on or near your property, you may ask us to remove or adjust it using the contact details below, and we will review your request and act on it where appropriate.

8. Teams and arenas

A match uses one shared outdoor arena based on the real-world area of the outdoor player or players.

If multiple outdoor players are too far apart to share one arena, the lobby may block match start and ask the team to move closer or add AI.

Solo play uses a local practice arena and does not count toward public scores, wins, streaks, leaderboards, or team statistics.

9. AI players and AI enemies

AI players are computer-controlled. AI players may fill friendly slots or enemy teams. Real enemy availability is not guaranteed, and AI enemy fallback may be offered.

10. Enemy teams

Enemy scope may be Local, Country, Global, or AI. A real enemy team may not always be available. If no real enemy is available, Triangulate may offer an AI enemy.

11. Unranked AI and solo play

Games with AI players and solo practice are unranked in this version.

This means those matches do not submit:

  • leaderboard scores;
  • public wins;
  • public losses;
  • streaks;
  • public team statistics.

We may still record internal match information to test fairness, improve gameplay, fix bugs, and understand whether AI and solo play are working properly.

12. Fair play

You must play fairly.

You must not:

  • spoof GPS;
  • fake location data;
  • use modified clients;
  • use unauthorised bots or scripts;
  • exploit bugs;
  • interfere with another player's device, account, or marker;
  • use multiple accounts to gain an unfair advantage;
  • manipulate matchmaking;
  • abuse invite codes;
  • attempt to bypass role rules.

We may cancel a match, block a player from starting, remove match results, restrict features, or suspend an account where reasonably necessary to protect safety, security, or fair play.

13. Anti-cheat and automated checks

To keep play fair and safe, we run automated checks on gameplay and location-quality signals, for example to detect GPS spoofing, impossible movement, or abuse. These checks may automatically pause your play, freeze your marker, block a match start, or remove a result.

These checks are necessary to provide a fair game and to protect other players. Where an automated decision has a significant effect on you, you can ask us to review it and you can ask for a person to look at it. Your data-protection rights in relation to automated decisions are explained in our Privacy Policy.

14. Your content and online safety

Triangulate may let you submit nicknames, event details, messages, feedback, or other content. You keep ownership of content you submit. By submitting content, you grant us a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, transferable, and sub-licensable licence to host, store, copy, display, adapt, and share that content for the purposes of operating, securing, improving, and promoting Triangulate.

You must have the right to share any content you submit, and it must not be unlawful, abusive, harassing, threatening, hateful, misleading, infringing, or otherwise in breach of these terms. You must not use Triangulate to share illegal content or content that is harmful to others, in particular to children.

We may, but are not obliged to, review, moderate, remove, or restrict content and accounts, and we may report unlawful content or conduct to the authorities, in line with our obligations as an online service. If you encounter content or behaviour that breaches these terms, you can report it to us using the contact details below.

15. Intellectual property and trade marks

All intellectual property rights in Triangulate, including the app, the website, the game design, software, source and object code, graphics, artwork, sounds, text, look and feel, databases, and branding, are owned by or licensed to Ziv Lazar LTD and are protected by copyright, database rights, trade mark rights, and other laws. We reserve all rights not expressly granted to you.

You are granted a limited, personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-sub-licensable, revocable licence to use Triangulate for your own personal, non-commercial play, in accordance with these terms.

"Triangulate" is a registered trade mark of Ziv Lazar LTD, registered with the UK Intellectual Property Office:

  • Trade Mark Number: UK00004388424
  • Mark: Triangulate
  • Series of Marks: 2
  • Class: 41

Except as allowed by law or with our prior written permission, you must not:

  • copy, reproduce, modify, adapt, translate, distribute, publicly display, or create derivative works from Triangulate or its content;
  • reverse engineer, decompile, or disassemble the app, except to the limited extent the law does not allow this to be prevented;
  • scrape, crawl, harvest, or use any automated means to extract data from Triangulate, including leaderboard, event, place, or player data;
  • use Triangulate or its content for text and data mining, or to develop, train, or improve any machine-learning or artificial-intelligence system. We expressly reserve our rights in this regard, including under Article 4 of the Digital Single Market Directive and any equivalent United Kingdom provision;
  • use our name, trade marks, logos, or branding, or anything confusingly similar.

16. Changes to the service

We may change, suspend, or discontinue parts of Triangulate at any time. We do not guarantee that the service will always be available, uninterrupted, accurate, or error-free.

17. Our responsibility and limitation of liability

Triangulate is provided on an as-is and as-available basis. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we make no warranties, conditions, or representations, whether express or implied, about the service, its availability, accuracy, completeness, security, or fitness for any particular purpose.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss or damage arising from or in connection with:

  • your use of, or inability to use, Triangulate;
  • unsafe, unlawful, or careless play, including any injury, accident, loss, or damage that occurs whilst playing Outdoors;
  • reliance on any map, route, position, marker, arena, place data, event information, or objective shown in the app;
  • any event, meet-up, venue, or location, and the acts or conduct of other players, event participants, or third parties;
  • third-party services, networks, devices, or open-data sources;
  • any loss of profit, revenue, business, goodwill, data, or any indirect or consequential loss.

Where we are liable to you and that liability is not excluded by law, our total aggregate liability to you for all claims arising out of or in connection with Triangulate and these terms is limited to one hundred pounds (£100), reflecting that Triangulate is provided to you free of charge.

Nothing in these terms excludes or limits our liability where it would be unlawful to do so, including liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, or for fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation, or any other liability that cannot be excluded or limited under the Unfair Contract Terms Act 1977, the Consumer Rights Act 2015, or other applicable law. These terms do not affect your statutory rights as a consumer, which always apply.

18. Events outside our control

We are not responsible for any failure or delay in providing Triangulate that is caused by events outside our reasonable control, including network or device failures, outages of third-party services or data sources, acts of God, severe weather, or other circumstances we could not reasonably foresee or prevent.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.bodyHtml:
Privacy Policy

Legal version: 2026-05-31

Triangulate is a team-based outdoor map game. Each team has three player slots. A player can take part as an outdoor real player, with AI support where available, or in solo practice.

This Privacy Policy explains how Ziv Lazar LTD collects and uses your personal data when you use Triangulate, and your rights under UK data protection law. That law includes the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), the Data Protection Act 2018 as amended by the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025, and the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations 2003 (PECR).

Outdoor players move using live device location. AI players are computer-controlled players that can fill friendly or enemy slots. The personal data we collect depends on how you choose to play. We use live GPS only when a real player chooses to play Outdoors and gives consent for that role.

1. Who we are and how to contact us

The data controller for your personal data is Ziv Lazar LTD, a company registered in England and Wales, whose registered office is at 15 Crusoe Mews, London, N16 0BQ, United Kingdom. If you have any questions about this policy or your personal data, please use the privacy or support contact shown on the Triangulate website or in the app, or write to us at the registered office above.

2. What Triangulate is

Triangulate lets teams of three form triangles on a map. The main game entry is play a game. The lobby lets players invite friends, find teammates, add AI, and choose an enemy type.

3. Children and family play

Triangulate is intended for a general audience and is not aimed at young children. Children should use Triangulate only with parent or guardian permission. Parents or guardians decide whether a child may play Outdoors.

We follow the Information Commissioner's Office Age Appropriate Design Code (the Children's Code). In practice this means privacy-protective defaults, collecting only the data we need, keeping precise location switched off until a player chooses to play Outdoors, and not using designs that push users to share more data or weaken their privacy settings.

Triangulate does not knowingly create child-specific profiles, does not sell personal data, and does not use precise location for targeted advertising or for any automated profiling for marketing.

4. Information we collect

  • Account and profile information: a randomly generated player ID, nickname, colour, recovery code, preferences, and consent records.
  • Lobby and team information: team slots, invite code use, team colour, team name, ready state, blockers, AI usage, and enemy choice.
  • Location and movement information: outdoor live device location, location accuracy, timestamps, speed, direction, route data, and fair-play signals where needed.
  • Gameplay information: match participation, round results, wins, duration, arena type, AI usage, enemy type, solo practice activity, and unranked AI results.
  • Content you submit: nicknames, event details, in-game messages, and feedback.
  • Optional fitness and health information: where you choose to connect Apple Health or Health Connect, activity data such as steps, distance, or exercise that supports outdoor activity tracking. This is special category data and is explained in section 6.
  • Device information: device type, platform, app state, and diagnostics used for compatibility and stability.
  • Analytics events: app events used to improve gameplay and reliability.

5. Our lawful bases and your consent for location

Under the UK GDPR, we rely on the following lawful bases to process your personal data:

  • Consent: for processing your precise location data when you choose to play Outdoors, and for connecting optional fitness tracking. You can withdraw consent at any time.
  • Performance of a contract, or taking steps at your request: to provide the game, build teams, and run matches you ask to take part in.
  • Legitimate interests: to keep the service secure, prevent cheating and abuse, fix bugs, and improve gameplay and reliability, where this is not overridden by your rights. Where the law allows, this may include recognised legitimate interests such as detecting, preventing, and investigating crime and ensuring the security of our network and systems.
  • Legal obligation: where we must process data to comply with the law, including online safety and the handling of unlawful content.

We treat your precise location with particular care. In line with PECR, including Regulation 14 on the processing of location data, your location data is processed only with your consent and only to provide the value-added service of Outdoors play. We process it only to the extent, and for the duration, necessary to provide that service.

Your consent for location is specific and granular. It is given by a separate, deliberate action and is not bundled with your acceptance of the Terms of Service or this Privacy Policy, and consent for fitness tracking is requested separately again. We never rely on pre-ticked boxes, silence, or inactivity as consent.

You can withdraw your consent at any time by turning off location access in your device settings, or by not playing Outdoors. Withdrawing consent does not affect any processing that took place before you withdrew it. If you turn off location access, you may not be able to start or join outdoor games.

6. Special category data and fitness tracking

If you choose to connect Apple Health or Health Connect, we may process health and fitness data such as steps, distance, or exercise to support outdoor activity tracking. Health and fitness data is "special category" data under the UK GDPR and is given extra protection.

We process this data only on the basis of your separate, explicit consent, which is requested apart from your acceptance of these documents and from the location consent for Outdoors play. Connecting fitness tracking is entirely optional, you can decline or skip it, and you can withdraw your consent at any time in your device or app settings. If you do not connect it, you can still play Triangulate.

7. Account and profile information

We use profile information to identify your player marker, save preferences, recover your profile, show your chosen name and colour, and keep consent records.

8. Lobby and team information

We use lobby and team information to build a team, invite friends, find teammates, add AI, choose Enemy: Local | Country | Global | AI, check whether a match can start, and sync the same team state across devices.

9. Location and movement information

Outdoors:

  • uses live device location;
  • requires usable GPS;
  • may require Precise Location, depending on your device;
  • uses fair-play and safety checks;
  • may be blocked if GPS quality is poor.

You can turn off location access in your device settings. If you do this, you may not be able to start or join outdoor games.

10. Outdoors role

If you play Outdoors, live device location is used while outdoor play is active. Outdoors players may require GPS, Precise Location, location accuracy, timestamps, speed, direction, route data, and fair-play signals.

Outdoor location data is used to place the player in the arena, move the player marker, check arena compatibility, check GPS quality, prevent cheating, and keep the match fair. We stop using your live location when outdoor play ends.

11. AI players

Triangulate may use AI players to fill empty friendly slots or enemy teams.

AI players are computer-controlled. They do not represent a real person, and they do not have personal location data. AI movement is generated by the game using simulated road or path behaviour.

We may use AI players when a team has an empty slot, no real enemy team is available, a player chooses to add AI, or a match needs an AI fallback.

12. Gameplay information

Games with AI players and solo practice are unranked in this version. They do not submit leaderboard scores, public wins, public losses, streaks, or public team statistics.

Internal analytics may still be used to test fairness, improve gameplay, fix bugs, and monitor safety.

13. Automated decisions and anti-cheat

To keep play fair and safe, we run automated checks on location-quality and gameplay signals, for example to detect GPS spoofing, impossible movement, or abuse. These checks may automatically pause your play, freeze your marker, block a match start, or remove a result.

We carry out this processing because it is necessary to provide a fair game and to protect players. Where a solely automated decision produces a significant effect on you, you have the right to be told about it, to ask for a person to review it, to express your point of view, and to contest it. To do so, contact us using the details in this policy.

14. Device and technical information

Internet connectivity is required for multiplayer sessions, lobby and team matching, events, operational diagnostics, and app reliability. We may collect device type, platform, app state, crash or diagnostic information, and network quality signals.

15. In-game content and online safety

If you submit nicknames, event details, messages, or feedback, we process that content to operate those features and to keep the service safe. As an online service, we may review, moderate, remove, or restrict content and accounts, and may report unlawful content or conduct to the authorities, in order to comply with our online-safety duties and to protect users, especially children.

Messages sent to other players during a match are shared with the players in that match. Do not share personal or sensitive information you do not want other players to see.

16. Who can see your location or movement

During a match, other players in the same match may see your player marker on the game map. This can include your teammates and enemy players.

If you play Outdoors, your player marker is based on your live device location while outdoor play is active.

For normal gameplay, we do not collect account email addresses or parent or guardian contact details. If you contact us separately for support, we use those contact details for support and do not show them to other players.

17. How we use location to create an arena

A match takes place in one arena.

Outdoor matches use the real-world area of the outdoor player or players. If more than one outdoor player is on the team, we check whether those players are close enough to share one arena.

Solo practice uses a local practice arena and does not submit ranked results.

18. How we use your information

We use information to provide the game, build teams, sync lobbies, move player markers, create arenas, match enemies, provide AI fallback, show game state, run unranked AI and solo play, improve gameplay, fix bugs, monitor safety, prevent cheating, moderate content, and operate events and support.

19. Who we share information with, and international transfers

Triangulate uses trusted service providers for hosting, databases, maps and place data, analytics, app distribution, and operational support. These providers process data on our behalf as our processors, under contracts that require appropriate safeguards, and they are not permitted to sell your precise location to advertisers.

Some of our providers are based outside the United Kingdom. Where we transfer personal data outside the UK, we do so only where there is an adequacy decision, an International Data Transfer Agreement or the UK Addendum to the EU Standard Contractual Clauses, or another safeguard recognised under UK data protection law, so that your data remains protected.

20. How long we keep information

Gameplay and profile data may be retained while your profile is active. Consent records are retained so we can show which legal version was accepted. We keep location data only as long as needed to provide and check Outdoors play, and then delete or anonymise it in line with our retention practices.

21. Your rights

Under the UK GDPR, you have the right to:

  • access the personal data we hold about you;
  • ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data;
  • ask us to delete your data;
  • restrict or object to our processing;
  • ask for portability of certain data;
  • not be subject to a solely automated decision that has a significant effect on you, and to ask for human review of such a decision;
  • withdraw consent at any time where we rely on consent, including for location and for fitness tracking.

You can change app permissions in your device settings at any time. To exercise your rights, contact us using the details above. When you make a request, we will carry out a reasonable and proportionate search for your data and respond within the time limits set by law.

If you have a concern, you have the right to complain to us directly, and we will acknowledge your complaint and look into it. You also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO), the UK supervisory authority, at ico.org.uk, although we would welcome the chance to address your concerns first.

22. Contact details

The data controller is Ziv Lazar LTD, registered office 15 Crusoe Mews, London, N16 0BQ, United Kingdom. Use the privacy or support contact shown on the Triangulate website or in the app, or the contact form. See also our Terms of Service.

23. Changes to this policy

When this policy changes, we publish a new legal version. Your consent record stores the legal version you accepted.
